name: platform/self-hosted
description: Shared multi-tenant backend platform: auth, content, analytics, pay services

scripts.lint: for d in apps/*; do (cd $d && ./vendor/bin/pint --test ../../packages/cms app) || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:fix: for d in apps/*; do (cd $d && ./vendor/bin/pint ../../packages/cms app) || exit 1; done
scripts.stan: for d in apps/*; do (cd $d && ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for d in apps/*; do (cd $d && ./vendor/bin/pest) || exit 1; done
